howtos.title: Build a mentor notebook from someone's YouTube videos
howtos.what: Ruben Hassid loads a mentor's longest videos into Google's notebook tool so answers lean toward that mentor's views.
copy: Go to Google's notebook tool and click Create notebook.
In the Sources box, type: “Latest and longest YouTube videos of [NAME] on [TOPIC].”
Untick the videos made by other people.
Untick the “Deep Research Report”; it must be “Fast research”.
Ask your question. The answer is biased like a mentor's, with all sources listed.
howtos.whenToUse: When generic AI answers aren't enough and you want advice shaped by a specific expert's long-form talks.
